title: Inside the 300 MW Butimanu development
excerpt: A closer look at the people, planning and field coordination behind one of Romania's largest photovoltaic developments.
alt: Field operations at the Butimanu photovoltaic development
intro: GreenTech Professionals is contributing electrical and mechanical installation capability to the 300 MW photovoltaic development in Butimanu, Romania.

sections.title: Scale requires coordination
paragraphs: A project of this size brings together technical decisions, site logistics and a large field workforce. More than 200 skilled professionals were reported on site, supported by a dedicated management team.
Daily coordination keeps electrical and mechanical activities aligned while work advances across a large and active construction area.

sections.title: Delivery in the field
paragraphs: The execution scope combines photovoltaic assembly, cable routing and electrical installation. Each stage depends on clear sequencing, consistent checks and communication between teams.
Butimanu also reflects GreenTech Professionals' continued growth in the Romanian renewable energy market.

title: Build what comes next with GreenTech PRO
excerpt: Discover the company, the field environment and the official route for submitting an application.
alt: GreenTech Professionals field team at a photovoltaic project
intro: GreenTech Professionals continues to grow and welcomes applications from people who want to contribute to the next generation of energy infrastructure.

sections.title: Work with teams close to delivery
paragraphs: Our work brings technical and field teams together across photovoltaic, electrical, mechanical and construction projects in European markets.
The careers process is designed to collect your preferred role, experience, contact details and supporting CV or references.

sections.title: How to apply
paragraphs: Use the official careers form to review the available options and submit your application directly to GreenTech Professionals.
Open opportunities may change as projects and operational requirements evolve, so the careers page remains the authoritative source.

title: Politehnica students visit the Butimanu site
excerpt: A technical site visit connected the next generation of engineers with active photovoltaic construction.
alt: GreenTech Professionals team activity at the Butimanu site
intro: Students from Politehnica University visited the Butimanu solar park for a practical view of photovoltaic construction and field delivery.

sections.title: Learning on active infrastructure
paragraphs: The visit offered direct exposure to the scale, sequencing and technical coordination involved in a major photovoltaic development.
Site-based learning helps connect engineering principles with the decisions and constraints teams manage during execution.

sections.title: Knowledge shared by field teams
paragraphs: Technical specialists and installation teams guided the visit and shared practical context from the project.
The initiative reflects an ongoing interest in technical education and in the people who will shape future energy infrastructure.
